notes: Spec written (docs/trace-format.md). synth.py and measure_gate.py both emit it; features.py consumes both.

notes: Uses ioctl path. Works against full-stub build from week 3.

title: Synthetic trace generator (unblocks training before real hooks exist)
notes: Done and verified. 20002 records, 9 scenarios incl. the exfiltration path. Labels are label_source=synth and are NOT evidence.

title: Label taxonomy + labelled dataset (reversible/deferrable/irreversible)
notes: The taxonomy IS a paper contribution. Two people label independently; report agreement.

title: Feature extraction: syscall nr / path hash / fd type / port / tx depth
notes: Done and verified. 16 u8 features matching struct tx_features exactly. tx_depth is constant (we flatten) - expected.

title: Train float classifier in userspace + accuracy baseline
notes: Done and verified. Tree beats MLP on irrevocable recall (0.978 vs 0.344 unbalanced, 1.000 balanced). Class balance is 95/2/1/2 - read balanced accuracy, never accuracy.

title: int8 quantization + accuracy delta measurement
notes: Done and verified. int8 is 6.9x smaller; COST 10 irrevocable detections (recall 1.000 -> 0.889). Safety regression - raise TX_CONFIDENCE_MIN or ship the tree.

title: Export weights into a BPF map blob
notes: Done and verified. 812B mlp / 3096B tree, byte-identical to C sizeof(). t06_weights.sh + t06_sabotage.sh: 8 real breakages detected, 0 missed.

title: Fixed-point forward pass in eBPF + sigmoid LUT + verifier wrangling
kernel_concept: eBPF verifier; bounded loops; no-FP constraint
notes: HARDEST FRAGMENT. Verifier rejects floats and unbounded loops. Use bpf_loop(). Fallback: quantized decision tree as nested ifs.

title: Benchmark harness + result CSV format + plotting
notes: CSV format defined and enforced by tools/bench/run.py. 5 malformed inputs rejected; TEMPLATE_bench.sh conforms. P1-P3 emit into this.

title: Fault-injection corpus (destructive agent actions)
notes: rm -rf; corrupt build; overwrite config. Measure recovery vs git-reset baseline.

title: Adversarial corpus (prompt injections)
notes: Injections planted in files the agent reads. Measure containment rate.

title: Figures: latency-vs-accuracy / overhead / containment / taxonomy split
notes: Fig 1 is in-kernel inference latency vs userspace daemon. That is the headline.

title: Deadlock corpus + victim-policy comparison
notes: Simulator done and verified: 4 scenarios, 4 policies. Emits sim:true on every event. NOT a kernel measurement - nothing in src/ implements a wait-for graph yet.
